customManagers.description: appVersion in Chart.yaml is the LibreNMS image tag.

packageRules.description: LibreNMS image tags are not always three-part: 26.9.1.1 has four. Docker versioning calls a different part count incompatible and drops the version before an update is computed, so this dependency uses loose versioning.
Updates under charts/ change what the chart deploys and are user-facing. CI actions and tooling stay chore.
The LibreNMS image is what the chart ships, not a dependency of it. A new release train is a feature.
An upstream LibreNMS hotfix is a fix.
